01

“the piercing star”

An explanation transmitted from Mujāhid ibn Jabr (Q 86:3).

01
Explanation from Mujāhid 01

Mujāhid ibn Jabr

English
Transmission wording
Abd al-Rahman informed us, he said: Ibrahim narrated to us, he said: Adam narrated to us, he said: Warqa’ narrated to us, from Ibn Abi Najih, from Mujahid, regarding His saying:
the piercing star [al-Tariq: 3]: “the one that blazes.”
العربية
الإسناد
أنبأ عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ، قَالَ: نا إِبْرَاهِيمُ، قَالَ: ثنا آدَمُ، قَالَ: ثنا وَرْقَاءُ، عَنِ ابْنِ أَبِي نَجِيحٍ، عَنْ مُجَاهِدٍ، فِي قَوْلِهِ:
النَّجْمُ الثَّاقِبُ [الطارق: 3] «الَّذِي يَتَوَهَّجُ»
Edition record 373811 · p. 720Link to report ↗
02

“the breastbones (al-tara’ib)”

An explanation transmitted from Mujāhid ibn Jabr (Q 86:7).

02
Explanation from Mujāhid 02

Mujāhid ibn Jabr

English
Transmission wording
Abd al-Rahman informed us, he said: Ibrahim narrated to us, he said: Adam narrated to us, he said: Warqa’ narrated to us, from Ibn Abi Najih, from Mujahid:
the breastbones (al-tara’ib) [al-Tariq: 7]: “below the collarbones.”
العربية
الإسناد
أنبأ عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا إِبْرَاهِيمُ، قَالَ: نا آدَمُ، قَالَ: نا وَرْقَاءُ، عَنِ ابْنِ أَبِي نَجِيحٍ، عَنْ مُجَاهِدٍ:
التَّرَائِبِ [الطارق: 7] «أَسْفَلُ مِنَ التَّرَاقِي»
Edition record 373812 · p. 720Link to report ↗
03

“Indeed, He is able to return him”

An explanation transmitted from Mujāhid ibn Jabr (Q 86:8).

03
Explanation from Mujāhid 03

Mujāhid ibn Jabr

English
Transmission wording
Abd al-Rahman informed us, he said: Ibrahim narrated to us, he said: Adam narrated to us, he said: Warqa’ narrated to us, from Ibn Abi Najih, from Mujahid:
Indeed, He is able to return him [al-Tariq: 8], he said: “He says: He is able to return the sperm into the urethra.”
العربية
الإسناد
أنبأ عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ، قَالَ: نا إِبْرَاهِيمُ، قَالَ: ثنا آدَمُ قَالَ: نا وَرْقَاءُ، عَنِ ابْنِ أَبِي نَجِيحٍ، عَنْ مُجَاهِدٍ:
إِنَّهُ عَلَى رَجْعِهِ لَقَادِرٌ [الطارق: 8] ، قَالَ: " يَقُولُ: إِنَّهُ لَعَلَى رَجْعِ النُّطْفَةِ فِي الْإِحْلِيلِ لَقَادِرٌ "
Edition record 373813 · p. 720Link to report ↗
04

“then he will have no power and no helper”

An explanation transmitted from Sufyān al-Thawrī (Q 86:10).

04
Explanation from Sufyān al-Thawrī 04

Sufyān al-Thawrī

English
Transmission wording
Abd al-Rahman informed us, he said: Ibrahim narrated to us, he said: Adam narrated to us, he said: Damra ibn Rabiʿa narrated to us, from Sufyan al-Thawri, regarding His saying:
then he will have no power and no helper [al-Tariq: 10], he said: “Power is the clan, and the helper is the ally.”
العربية
الإسناد
أنبأ عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ، قَالَ: نا إِبْرَاهِيمُ، قَالَ: ثنا آدَمُ، قَالَ: ثنا ضَمْرَةُ بْنُ رَبِيعَةَ، عَنْ سُفْيَانَ الثَّوْرِيِّ، فِي قَوْلِهِ:
فَمَا لُهُ مِنْ قُوَّةٍ وَلَا نَاصِرٍ [الطارق: 10] قَالَ: " الْقُوَّةُ الْعَشِيرَةُ، وَالنَّاصِرُ: الْحَلِيفُ "
Edition record 373814 · p. 720Link to report ↗
05

“By the heaven that returns”

An explanation transmitted from Mujāhid ibn Jabr (Q 86:11).

05
Explanation from Mujāhid 05

Mujāhid ibn Jabr

English
Transmission wording
Abd al-Rahman informed us, he said: Ibrahim narrated to us, he said: Adam narrated to us, he said: Warqa’ narrated to us, from Ibn Abi Najih, from Mujahid:
By the heaven that returns [al-Tariq: 11], meaning: “the one with clouds; he says: it rains, then it returns again with rain.”
العربية
الإسناد
أنبأ عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ، قَالَ: ثنا إِبْرَاهِيمُ، قَالَ: ثنا آدَمُ، قَالَ: ثنا وَرْقَاءُ، عَنِ ابْنِ أَبِي نَجِيحٍ، عَنْ مُجَاهِدٍ:
وَالسَّمَاءِ ذَاتِ الرَّجْعِ [الطارق: 11] ، يَعْنِي: " ذَاتَ السَّحَابِ يَقُولُ: تُمْطِرُ، ثُمَّ تَرْجِعُ بِالْمَطَرِ "
Edition record 373815 · p. 720Link to report ↗
06

“and the earth that splits”

An explanation transmitted from Mujāhid ibn Jabr (Q 86:12).

06
Explanation from Mujāhid 06

Mujāhid ibn Jabr

English
Transmission wording
Abd al-Rahman informed us, he said: Ibrahim narrated to us, he said: Adam narrated to us, he said: Warqa’ narrated to us, from Ibn Abi Najih, from Mujahid:
and the earth that splits [al-Tariq: 12], he said: “The split (al-sadʿ) is like a mountain pass, other than valleys and other than steep banks.”
العربية
الإسناد
أنبأ عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ، قَالَ: نا إِبْرَاهِيمُ، قَالَ: نا آدَمُ، قَالَ: ثنا وَرْقَاءُ، عَنِ ابْنِ أَبِي نَجِيحٍ، عَنْ مُجَاهِدٍ:
وَالْأَرْضِ ذَاتِ الصَّدْعِ [الطارق: 12] قَالَ: «الصَّدْعُ مِثْلُ الْمَأْزِمِ غَيْرِ الْأَوْدِيَةِ وَغَيْرِ الْجُرُفِ»
Edition record 373816 · p. 721Link to report ↗
07

“and it is not amusement”

An explanation transmitted from Mujāhid ibn Jabr (Q 86:14).

07
Explanation from Mujāhid 07

Mujāhid ibn Jabr

English
Transmission wording
Abd al-Rahman informed us, he said: Ibrahim narrated to us, he said: Adam narrated to us, he said: Warqa’ narrated to us, from Ibn Abi Najih, from Mujahid:
and it is not amusement [al-Tariq: 14], he says: “It is not play.”
العربية
الإسناد
أنبأ عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ، قَالَ: نا إِبْرَاهِيمُ قَالَ: نا آدَمُ، قَالَ: ثنا وَرْقَاءُ، عَنِ ابْنِ أَبِي نَجِيحٍ، عَنْ مُجَاهِدٍ:
وَمَا هُوَ بِالْهَزْلِ [الطارق: 14] يَقُولُ: «مَا هُوَ بِاللَّعِبِ»
